title: Patch: rename six cards whose names wouldn't pass Roblox moderation
notes: Issue #2953 (part of #2898): renamed on every platform so the names pass Roblox's Community Standards: core-002 Bigot is Speciesist, traininggrounds-041 Legacy: Bigot is Legacy: Speciesist, traininggrounds-029 Oriental is Easterner, stinkyscape-044 Great Replacement Theory is Great Paperclip Theory, core-042 Eugenics is Selective Breeding, core-090 CN-Viral Injection is Super-Virus Injection, core-090-1 CN-Virus is Super-Virus, meditative-061 Joon Jorker is Joon Juicer; the texts of core-090, meditative-095-1 and stinkyscape-088 name the new names. Ids, costs, stats, effects, tags and pictures are unchanged (--visual: motifs.ts and traininggrounds.ts keep the renamed cards' pictures).

player.title: Eight cards renamed
text: Eight cards have new names: Speciesist, Legacy: Speciesist, Easterner, Great Paperclip Theory, Selective Breeding, Super-Virus Injection, Super-Virus and Joon Juicer.
Siva 2, Super-Virus Injection and CN Golem name the renamed cards in their text. Nothing plays differently.
